summary: Jirafeau is a web application designed for one-click file sharing. Users can select a file, upload it to the server, and immediately obtain a link to distribute.
goodFor: It is a suitable choice if you need a straightforward, self-hosted utility to quickly transfer files to others without configuring complex user accounts or cloud storage integrations.
watchOut: The repository lacks recent activity and a tagged release history, suggesting that you may need to rely on the community or patch issues yourself.
deployNotes: Because the application runs on PHP, you will typically need a standard web server configuration with PHP support or a Docker container setup, alongside persistent storage for the uploaded files.
